dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave spline along the trailing edge, originating from a narrow apex and curving posteriorly toward the dorsal ridge junction.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small pixel radius; rounded apex morphology.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50-degree convex slope relative to the horizontal longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width is approximately 0.9x the maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Moderate convex curvature forming a smooth arc from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust beak profile with a thick vertical base and a length approximately 0.4x the melon's longitudinal width.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 135 degrees at the pixel junction where the melon slope meets the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity iridescent cyan-white specular highlights along the mid-lateral and dorsal surfaces; small vertical protrusion on the anterior margin of the tail fluke.
